entries.title: A card you are typing in stays in front when another card arrives
entries.body: While you type in a card's text box, on your Mac, iPhone or iPad, a new card that would normally come to the front now waits as a new card one page away. The card you are typing in stays on screen and keeps your cursor and keyboard, so your next letters land where you were typing.
entries.noPicture: Nothing looks different: the card you are typing in simply stays where it was.
